messages:
mike: Quick kitchen PSA — espresso machine blew a seal this morning, so no espresso shots until repairs. Anyone up for a coffee run? I'm heading out in 20.
sara: Oh no. Yes please, I'm low on cold brew pods. Could you pick up oat milk and a cinnamon roll? @mike :pray:
devin: Also the fridge is leaking again, left a note on the sink. Facilities ticket filed: #3216
liz: I can grab oat milk and almond milk if mike wants to split. I'm on a 10:30 schedule.
mike: Cool — calling dibs on the local cafe. Anyone wants anything sweet? @sara @liz
sara: cinnamon roll + 1 croissant pls. And almond milk for my latte.
ops-bot: [automated] Facilities ticket #3216 updated: assigned to Jorge. ETA ~2 hours.
devin: can someone check the snack cupboard before buying more chips? It's a mystery box back there.
liz: Heads up — we ran out of the gluten-free crackers last week. Left a sticky note on the shelf.
mike: I'll do a quick inventory pic and post back.
mike: Inventory snapshot:
```
Coffee pods: 6
Oat milk: 0
Almond milk: 1
Gluten-free crackers: 0
Protein bars: 12
```
anna: Thanks mike! If you pass by Whole Foods, their oat milk is on promo this week.
sara: Prefer oat barista for froth if possible.
devin: Also, can we put a small sign on the espresso machine so people don't try to use it? It sparked when it failed.
liz: I'll tape something up: "Out of order — DO NOT TOUCH" + :warning:
mike: OK I'll pick up: 2 oat barista, 1 almond, cinnamon roll, croissant, 6 cold brew pods. DM me payments. Anyone want decaf?
anna: Decaf please.
sara: I'll Venmo $6 to @mike for my stuff.
mike: cool thx :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder: Kitchen fridge cleaning scheduled Friday 9am.
devin: also, can we update the shared snack budget doc? Link: https://redwood.company/snacks (editable by ops).
liz: quick poll — do we prefer a reusable milk jug (bulk) or individual cartons? react with :milk: for bulk, :carton: for cartons.
mike: gonna head out now — back in 25.
jessie: Thanks for grabbing everything! Cinnamon roll was gone in minutes, 10/10 :clap:
